look.title: Pixel-sharp. Six time styles.
look.sub: Every font is redrawn on your watch's pixel grid, so even small text stays crisp. Switch time styles on the watch or in the app.

data.title: 29 data choices. Easy on battery.
data.sub: Change, restyle or hide every field. No GPS, no network, and data you don't show is never read.

look.title: 像素级清晰，6 种大时间字体
look.sub: 所有字体按手表像素网格重绘，小字也锐利不发虚；时间字体在手表或手机上一键切换。

data.title: 29 种数据随心配，省电不打折
data.sub: 每个数据位都能换数据、换样式或隐藏；不开 GPS、不联网，没显示的数据一项不读。

look.title: Six colour themes, native on every screen
look.sub: Classic, Amber, Glacier, Mint, Night glow and Sakura. AMOLED, colour MIP, mono Instinct and square screens each get native artwork.

data.title: A whole world of data in 62 KB
data.sub: Digital time, an analogue dial and a live day-and-night world map, with nine configurable data areas.

look.title: 6 套配色，每种屏幕原生绘制
look.sub: 经典、琥珀、冰川、薄荷、夜光、樱花；AMOLED、彩色 MIP、黑白本能和方屏都按原生分辨率绘制。

data.title: 62 KB 装下整个世界
data.sub: 数字时间、模拟小表盘、实时昼夜世界地图，再加 9 个可自定数据区。

look.title: Four mountains, made for every screen
look.sub: Summit, Ranges, Fuji and Everest, drawn separately for AMOLED, colour MIP and monochrome screens.

data.title: Bold time, your data, under 100 KB
data.sub: Seven fields, each changeable or hidden, including one left of the time on Instinct. Under 100 KB on every watch.

look.title: 4 款山峰，每种屏幕独立绘制
look.sub: 雪峰、群峰、富士、珠峰；AMOLED、彩色 MIP、黑白屏各自绘制，各有各的样子。

data.title: 大字时间，数据随你，不到 100 KB
data.sub: 7 个数据位都能更换或隐藏，本能系列新增时间左侧数据位；每台手表的安装包都小于 100 KB。
